query:
insert into underway.activity_call (
                id,
                task_queue_name,
                workflow_run_id,
                step_index,
                call_key,
                activity,
                input,
                timeout_ms,
                max_attempts,
                state
            ) values (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4,
                $5,
                $6,
                $7,
                $8,
                $9,
                'pending'::underway.activity_call_state
            )
            on conflict (task_queue_name, workflow_run_id, step_index, call_key) do nothing
